meta.nextStep: Close 8 operational conditions, then Production Deployment Authorization

infrastructure.notes: Docker/nginx configs complete. No cloud infrastructure provisioned. Terraform/kubernetes/helm are README stubs.

database.notes: Schema docs exist. No production database, no migration scripts, no backup/restore, no RTO/RPO.

security.notes: App-layer security (CSRF, headers, auth) complete. Secrets management, rate limiting, SSL certs needed.

observability.notes: Sentry, Prometheus, Grafana, health endpoints configured. Log aggregation, dashboards, alert routing needed.

deployment.notes: CI pipelines configured. No CD pipeline, no deployment strategy, release artifacts need finalization.

operations.notes: Runbooks exist. No incident response, no support framework, no maintenance procedures, no escalation matrix.

business.notes: Product docs, FAQ, contact, knowledge base ready. Release notes and version labeling need finalization.

overallReadiness.interpretation: Application code is RC2-certified and production-capable. Operational infrastructure requires completion. This is consistent with Phase 0 placeholder status.
